hardware.gradient: parameter shift (pi/4), each shifted term a separate noisy execution
hardware.measurement_strategy: MeasurementStrategy.probs(computation_space=UNBUNCHED); tr[M rho] = P(signal port 2, idler port 2)

hardware.simulator: MerLin CPU analytic simulator (float64); counts drawn from its exact probabilities
